_about: The second levels of two-letter ccTLDs (a generic label — co, com, net, org, gov, edu, web, id … public_suffix.CCTLD_SECOND_LEVELS — under a 2-letter TLD) that no section of the Public Suffix List lists. registrable_domain() (api/services/public_suffix.py) reads every such zone as a public suffix, as the compound-ccTLD heuristic did before 2026-10-28, so a stranger's name under it is a site of its own; only the zones under 'names' are read as one owner's name instead, as the PSL would read them. Splitting is the default because the two errors are not alike: an open zone read as one name makes every stranger under it one site with the attacker's, named 'co' or 'ne' to the brand and keyword checks (the 2026-10-28 final review found ChangeIP's and FreeDNS's free zones ne.pw, asn.im, or.lt, govt.hu … merged that way: 5,148 such zones exist, 1,844 with name servers), while one owner's zone read as a registry costs what it cost before 2026-10-28. 'names': one company's or organisation's own zone, with no restricted label (gov, edu, mil, sch, ac … — government zones stay split, as before; the extension's guard treats each as one site for its off-site check, _restrictedZoneOf), checked in DNS (SOA, NS) and on crt.sh; scripts/build_extension_scorer_data.py ships them to the extensions (cctldNames). 'registries': open zones of the same shape the default keeps split, with the evidence; no runtime effect — tests/test_public_suffix.py holds each to being split and off 'names'. Every zone here keeps the heuristic's shape and stays out of the PSL (tests). Sources: DNS on 2026-10-28, crt.sh (distinct names under the zone), the 2026-10-24 feed snapshot with all of Phishing.Database's links, SURBL's two-level-tlds list (https://www.surbl.org/static/two-level-tlds, fetched 2026-10-28), the Tranco top-1M of 2026-10-21.

names.id.me: ID.me, Inc.'s identity service (NS Cloudflare): account, api, assets, verify, help, shop …; top-1M #1,341. The extension's guard listed it as one site before 2026-10-28.

names.net.hr: The Net.hr portal (NS Cloudflare); crt.sh: 88 names, its sections and regional portals (magazin, forum, igre, dubrovackidnevnik, ezadar, kaportal …); top-100k #5,824.
names.or.cz: Petr Baudiš's domain (SOA pasky.or.cz, NS ns.or.cz); crt.sh: 23 names (repo — the public Git hosting, projects are paths there, not subdomains — pasky, baudis, tetrinet …); top-100k #27,189.
names.web.de: WEB.DE, 1&1 Mail & Media's mail portal (NS ns-webde.ui-dns.*, United Internet's); its sign-in is on subdomains (login, anmelden, auth); top-10k #2,424. The extension's guard listed it as one site before 2026-10-28.
